subject: Evaluation incentive structure and committal for Zennith RFP
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zennithtech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@zennithtech.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: additional pilot credits for RFP vs OrionAI

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're running a comparative bake-off next month against OrionAI and a couple of smaller vendors — evaluation window is Dec 6–17. To get a fair read on latency/cost at our scale we need more than the default trial allocation.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a 2-week evaluation grant (~350k tokens + 50 embeddings) and a short SLA addendum for the pilot (priority queue access during test windows)? Finance will ask for written confirmation and a simple MSA addendum.

We'd like to finalize incentives by Dec 2 so procurement can include it in the RFP packet. Our decision criteria: latency stability, cost per 1M tokens, and quality on a 10-sample diagnostic.

Happy to hop on a quick call today if that helps.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Data Platforms
Zennith Tech
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: RFP-timeline.xlsx (referenced)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional pilot credits for RFP vs OrionAI

Looping you both in to approve a promo commitment. Summary of ask from Zennith: 2-week grant (~350k tokens + 50 embeddings), short SLA addendum (priority queues during their test windows), and a signed one-page addendum for procurement. They need a written confirmation by Dec 2. Deal: ZEN-6219.

My thoughts: we can offer 300k tokens + 50 embeddings and a usage-SLA addendum (no financial credit, but elevated support during test windows). If acceptable, finance/legal should OK the MSA addendum (I attached a draft MAL-terms.docx). Marketing might consider covering the last 50k token via promotional fund if Marcus signs off.

Questions for Marcus/Sean:
- Marcus: can marketing promo cover the extra 50k tokens or should this come from sales credits?
- Sean: any objections from quota/SLA standpoint for priority queue for a 2-week window?

If we greenlight, I'll send a formal offer to Samantha and attach the MSA addendum and pilot-credits-agreement.pdf for signature.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional pilot credits for RFP vs OrionAI

Kim,

We can cover the extra 50k tokens from the campaign promo bucket for competitive bake-offs; please mark it as a promotional grant so accounting can track it. Approve the 300k + 50k promotional uplift. No funnel-level concessions beyond that.

Sean — no technical concerns from my side, but if priority queuing requires engineering changes or a sustained SLA we should limit it to specific test windows (date/time ranges) and document support scope.

Please make the offer conditional on a signed addendum and include a one-time usage cap in the agreement.

Marcus
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

> On Sat, Nov 28, 2026 at 09:12 Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > (quoted) 
> > "Hi Kimberly,
> > 
> > Thanks again for the demo last week...
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zennithtech.com>
Cc: procurement@zennithtech.com, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional pilot credits for RFP vs OrionAI

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the clear timeline. We can confirm the following conditional offer for the Zennith competitive evaluation:

- Pilot credits: 300,000 generation tokens + 50 embedding units (one-time grant)
- Priority support: dedicated response window during their declared test windows (Dec 6–17) — defined in the attached usage-sla-addendum.docx
- Legal: one-page MSA addendum (attached MAL-terms.docx) to be signed by procurement; offer valid until Dec 2
- Cap: a hard usage cap will be included in the agreement; exceed usage requires pre-approval (no automatic top-ups)

Next steps:
1) I'll share the pilot-credits-agreement.pdf and the short addendum via DocuSign (link below) for procurement signature.
2) Procurement signs the addendum by Dec 2 to lock in the grant.
3) We'll provision the credits prior to their first declared test window and schedule a 30-min standby during their test dates.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/REDWOOD/ZEN-6219

Attachments: pilot-credits-agreement.pdf, usage-sla-addendum.docx, MAL-terms.docx

If that works I'll send the DocuSign envelope now.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
